privateDeals.what: Apollo Sports Capital became majority shareholder of Atletico de Madrid (announced Nov 10, 2025; closed Mar 12, 2026). Quantum Pacific kept substantially all of its stake and is now the second-largest shareholder
Quantum Pacific Group bought Spain's Los Gallos SailGP team (Season 4 champions)
Kenon received ~$93M (its net share of a ~$203M payment) from Peru, settling the October 2023 ICSID award
OPC Energy issued NIS 600M (~$202M) of Series E bonds in Aug 2026 and closed financing for its Hadera expansion in June 2026
Eastern Pacific Shipping announced a strategic exit from chemical tanker operations

trophies.what: Stake in Atletico de Madrid (LaLiga) held through Quantum Pacific
Share of father Sammy Ofer's art collection (split with brother Eyal Ofer; reportedly includes Van Gogh and Picasso works)

policy.what: ICSID arbitration against Peru: Oct 2023 award for Kenon/IC Power; Peru's annulment bid was dismissed June 29, 2026 and Peru paid in Aug 2026, ending the case
Israel's Market Concentration Law lists Idan Ofer and the Israel Corp. group as 'concentrated entities', which limits OPC's large power-generation licensing and state-asset allocations
ICL's Dead Sea concession ends March 31, 2030. ICL says a new concession will likely come on less favorable, possibly materially less favorable, terms

giving.name: $42M to London Business School (Sammy Ofer Centre, opened Sept 2017)

gaps: No SEC person CIK found for Idan Ofer. Ansonia's Kenon stake comes from a July 2021 13D/A cited in the 2026 20-F. Forbes (Sept 2026) says he owns 48% of Israel Corp.; the ICL 20-F supports ~47.7% combined (Millenium + Lynav + direct). The exact Atletico % after the Apollo deal is not disclosed; Forbes' 28% may predate it. Eastern Pacific Shipping's site does not name its owner, so the Ofer link rests on the Kenon 20-F's 'same ultimate beneficiary' wording. The quantumpacific.com domain now redirects to an unrelated NZ site. No real estate verified (reported London residence only). Famalicao and art details are Forbes-only.
